title: 外倾短反手伸展
description: 赛璐璐画面中，胸前宽反手点与低脚点组成短距离伸展。

art_direction.medium: two-ink risograph with teal and coral spot colors and precise drawn anatomy
art_direction.scene: Create an original cel-shaded illustration of a fictional adult using a broad low undercling on a shallow overhanging bouldering wall. The supporting hand naturally holds the underside, both shoes remain on positive footholds, and the free hand reaches toward a nearby jug as one leg straightens modestly. Keep the feet close to continuous thick crash mats and avoid a deep back arch. A three-quarter medium-wide view includes the whole clothed adult, readable hold directions, wall angle, and empty landing. Use crisp navy outlines, bright peach planes, and selective mint highlights. The movement stays controlled. No jumps, cut-loose feet, text, brands, or dangerous exposure.
